quotes.text: It was like trying to do mechanical drawing while wearing oven mitts. Precision work with hands in open air is just not human-compatible.
quotes.author: Animats
quotes.source: Hacker News — William Gibson and the trademarking of cyberspace
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect grug-brained tech metaphor. Oven mitts VR CAD is instantly relatable and funny without any setup.

quotes.text: The 6502 is so primitive that it runs on an Atari equipped with 128 bytes of RAM. Yes, 128 bytes — used for code, data, video, and everything else. (But it can address 64 KB.) It is so primitive that it is unable to multiply integers.
quotes.author: bugake
quotes.source: Hacker News — Laptop Based on 6502 CPU
quotes.extraction_note: Fantastic fact that puts modern dev constraints in perspective. 128 bytes for code+data+video and no multiply instruction.
